 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21f38abeb186e0df901ece2d158aed5b8b4d3813f1117951c6454ec846ec4ff4.png] 

For **EJRN → HEUI**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c25fb6c56807b1f83f9e0fb5cc1071aa90a4e699eddb7a91d80e4154dd75c63.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4c18e1b772c78d23191e339efd1dedcfe70d69f869b79a6842e4eb50c2adc5a7.png]
